similarityReview: The 3D model accurately reconstructs the iconic semi-circular brick bay window turret of the Romanesque Revival rowhouse. It features a solid brick base, a multi-tiered cylindrical bay structure with arched glass windows, decorative brick cornices, and a triangular pediment roof at the lower level. The back and sides are fully enclosed to ensure a complete 3D volume, and all windows are modeled as separate glass elements slightly offset to prevent Z-fighting.
